problem: WeChat Pay v3 cryptographic foundation was incomplete: (a) createOrder/verifyPayment held a placeholder WXPAY_PRIVATE_KEY (merchant request signing impossible); (b) verifyPayment/queryOrder consumed the WeChat query response WITHOUT verifying its signature (unsigned provider response treated as payment authority); (c) payCallback had no HTTP trigger; (d) refundOrder returned fake refund success without calling the real refund API; (e) payCallback resource decryption assumed hex ciphertext (WeChat v3 sends Base64) and skipped cipher.final() GCM auth.

changes.SHARED_AUTHORITY: payCallback/lib/paymentAuthority.js is the single canonical authority module. Added isMockTransactionId/isMockPaymentResult, verifyResponseSignature(headers, rawBody, env) (RSA-SHA256, strict Wechatpay-Serial routing via buildAuthorities/routeAuthority/verifySignature, fail-closed), and decryptResource(resource, apiV3Key) (AEAD_AES_256_GCM, Base64 ciphertext, last-16-byte tag, cipher.final()). Synced byte-identical to createOrder/lib and verifyPayment/lib — no duplicated crypto.
changes.MERCHANT_SIGNING_UNCHANGED: Outbound signing stays 'merchant API private key + merchant API certificate serial' (WXPAY_PRIVATE_KEY + WXPAY_SERIAL_NO). WeChat public key / platform cert is verification-only and is NEVER used for merchant request signing.
changes.RESPONSE_VERIFY: createOrder/lib/payment.js + verifyPayment/lib/payment.js: _request() preserves original response body + headers; jsapiOrder and queryOrder now run verifyResponseSignature before trusting the payload. Fail-closed: unsigned/invalid response → success:false, tradeState:'UNVERIFIED' (queryOrder) → verifyPayment never marks paid / grants entitlement from an unverified response.
changes.CALLBACK_DECRYPT: payCallback uses shared decryptResource (Base64 + GCM auth tag) instead of the previous hex/32-char slice; verification + callback semantics no longer drift.
changes.REFUND_FAIL_CLOSED: refundOrder._processRefund returns success:false (REFUND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, failClosed) — never a fake 'refund success'. Production path cannot report success unless the real WeChat refund API is implemented and its authoritative response verifies. No order is marked 'refunded'.
changes.DEPLOY_GUARD: scripts/lib/secret-guard.js adds scanPaymentSigning (PEM + 40-hex serial value-shape) wired into scanFunction; new scripts/check-payment-signing.js CLI; new scripts/deploy-payment-functions.sh wrapper runs generic secret-clobber guard + payment-signing guard before any deploy.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/payment-signing-foundation.test.js (22 assertions): guard PASS/FAIL (placeholder key, wrong serial, missing key), merchant sign→verify PASS, wrong-key FAIL, signed response accept, tampered body FAIL, wrong pub-key-ID FAIL, missing headers FAIL, queryOrder rejects unsigned / accepts signed, callback sign+decrypt PASS, wrong key FAIL, tampered ciphertext FAIL, refund fail-closed. Registered in tests/rc8.9/run.js.

rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit>; code-only change (no secret values committed). Cloud-side env/trigger wiring is separate and reversible via scripts/set-env.sh.
